+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import plotly.graph_objects as go
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.table import Table
+
+from common import ROOT, save_plot
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--results", type=Path, default=ROOT / "results")
+    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=ROOT / "results" / "comparison.html")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    files = sorted(args.results.glob("approach*/**/metrics.json"))
+    records = []
+    for path in files:
+        records.append({"approach": path.parent.parent.name, "path": str(path), "payload": json.loads(path.read_text())})
+    table = Table(title="Q4 comparison")
+    table.add_column("Approach")
+    table.add_column("Fit seconds")
+    table.add_column("Headline metric")
+    for record in records:
+        payload = record["payload"]
+        if record["approach"] == "approach1":
+            years = payload["metrics"].get("years", [])
+            last = payload["metrics"].get("per_year", {}).get(str(max(years)), {}) if years else {}
+            headline = f"modularity={last.get('communities', {}).get('modularity', 'n/a')}"
+        else:
+            dimensions = payload["metrics"].get("dimensions", {})
+            best = payload["metrics"].get("best_sweep")
+            if best is None:
+                best_value = max((item.get("learned", {}).get("auc", 0.0), dimension) for dimension, item in dimensions.items()) if dimensions else (0.0, "n/a")
+                headline = f"best learned AUC={best_value[0]:.3f} (d={best_value[1]})"
+            else:
+                headline = f"best learned AUC={best['auc']:.3f} ({best['configuration']}, d={best['dimension']})"
+        table.add_row(record["approach"], f"{payload.get('fit_seconds', 0.0):.2f}", headline)
+    Console().print(table)
+    figure = go.Figure()
+    for record in records:
+        if record["approach"] == "approach2":
+            dimensions = record["payload"]["metrics"].get("dimensions", {})
+            x = sorted(int(value) for value in dimensions)
+            figure.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=[dimensions[str(value)]["learned"]["auc"] for value in x], mode="lines+markers", name="node2vec learned AUC"))
+    figure.update_layout(title="Q4 model comparison", xaxis_title="Embedding dimension", yaxis_title="AUC")
+    save_plot(figure, args.out)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+++ questions/q4/data/fetch.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import hashlib
+import json
+import subprocess
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import urlencode
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+RAW = ROOT / "data" / "raw"
+CLEAN = ROOT / "data" / "clean"
+API = "https://comtradeapi.un.org/public/v1/preview/C/A/HS"
+CHINA = 156
+
+COUNTRY_NAMES = {
+    32: "Argentina", 36: "Australia", 40: "Austria", 56: "Belgium",
+    76: "Brazil", 124: "Canada", 152: "Chile", 156: "China",
+    170: "Colombia", 191: "Croatia", 203: "Czechia", 208: "Denmark",
+    246: "Finland", 250: "France", 276: "Germany", 344: "Hong Kong",
+    356: "India", 360: "Indonesia", 364: "Iran", 372: "Ireland",
+    376: "Israel", 380: "Italy", 392: "Japan", 398: "Kazakhstan",
+    410: "South Korea", 458: "Malaysia", 484: "Mexico", 528: "Netherlands",
+    554: "New Zealand", 566: "Nigeria", 578: "Norway", 586: "Pakistan",
+    604: "Peru", 608: "Philippines", 616: "Poland", 620: "Portugal",
+    634: "Qatar", 643: "Russia", 682: "Saudi Arabia", 702: "Singapore",
+    710: "South Africa", 724: "Spain", 752: "Sweden", 756: "Switzerland",
+    764: "Thailand", 792: "Türkiye", 804: "Ukraine", 826: "United Kingdom",
+    834: "Tanzania", 842: "United States", 860: "Uzbekistan", 704: "Vietnam",
+}
+
+REGIONS = {
+    "East Asia": {156, 344, 392, 410, 704},
+    "South Asia": {356, 586},
+    "Southeast Asia": {360, 458, 608, 702, 764},
+    "Europe": {40, 56, 191, 203, 208, 246, 250, 276, 372, 380, 528, 616, 620, 643, 724, 752, 756, 804, 826},
+    "North America": {124, 484, 842},
+    "South America": {32, 76, 152, 170, 604},
+    "Middle East": {364, 376, 634, 682},
+    "Africa": {566, 729, 710, 834},
+    "Central Asia": {398, 860},
+    "Oceania": {36, 554},
+}
+
+
+def parse_years(value: str) -> list[int]:
+    if ":" in value:
+        start, end = (int(part) for part in value.split(":", maxsplit=1))
+        return list(range(start, end + 1))
+    return [int(part) for part in value.split(",")]
+
+
+def country_name(code: int) -> str:
+    return COUNTRY_NAMES.get(code, f"Partner {code}")
+
+
+def country_region(code: int) -> str:
+    for region, codes in REGIONS.items():
+        if code in codes:
+            return region
+    return "Other"
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def request_json(params: dict[str, str | int], target: Path, pause: float) -> dict:
+    if target.exists():
+        return json.loads(target.read_text())
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    query = urlencode(params).replace("%2C", ",")
+    url = f"{API}?{query}"
+    last_error: Exception | None = None
+    for attempt in range(4):
+        try:
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["curl", "--fail", "--silent", "--show-error", "--location", "--retry", "2", "--retry-all-errors", "--max-time", "30", url],
+                check=True,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+            )
+            payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
+            target.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+            time.sleep(pause)
+            return payload
+        except Exception as error:
+            last_error = error
+            try:
+                request = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "ap26-q4-trade-network/1.0"})
+                with urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
+                    payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+                target.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+                time.sleep(pause)
+                return payload
+            except Exception as fallback_error:
+                last_error = fallback_error
+                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"Comtrade request failed: {url}") from last_error
+
+
+def rows_for(payload: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    return payload.get("data", [])
+
+
+def value(row: dict) -> float:
+    raw = row.get("primaryValue")
+    if raw is None:
+        return 0.0
+    try:
+        return float(raw)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return 0.0
+
+
+def rank_china_partners(year: int, top_partners: int, pause: float) -> list[int]:
+    scores: dict[int, float] = {}
+    for flow in ("X", "M"):
+        target = RAW / f"china_{year}_{flow}.json"
+        payload = request_json(
+            {"reporterCode": CHINA, "period": year, "flowCode": flow, "cmdCode": "TOTAL", "partner2Code": 0, "customsCode": "C00"},
+            target,
+            pause,
+        )
+        for row in rows_for(payload):
+            partner = int(row.get("partnerCode", -1))
+            if partner not in {0, CHINA}:
+                scores[partner] = scores.get(partner, 0.0) + value(row)
+    return [code for code, _ in sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)[:top_partners]]
+
+
+def build_snapshot(years: list[int], top_partners: int, pause: float) -> tuple[list[dict], list[int]]:
+    anchor_year = max(years)
+    partners = rank_china_partners(anchor_year, top_partners, pause)
+    nodes = [CHINA, *partners]
+    node_set = set(nodes)
+    output: list[dict] = []
+    for year in years:
+        for reporter in nodes:
+            target = RAW / f"reporter_{reporter}_{year}_X.json"
+            payload = request_json(
+                {"reporterCode": reporter, "period": year, "flowCode": "X", "cmdCode": "TOTAL", "partnerCode": ",".join(str(code) for code in nodes), "partner2Code": 0, "customsCode": "C00"},
+                target,
+                pause,
+            )
+            for row in rows_for(payload):
+                partner = int(row.get("partnerCode", -1))
+                if partner in node_set and partner != reporter:
+                    output.append({
+                        "year": year,
+                        "reporter_code": reporter,
+                        "partner_code": partner,
+                        "trade_value_usd": value(row),
+                        "flow": "exports",
+                        "source": "UN Comtrade preview API",
+                    })
+    return output, nodes
+
+
+def write_csv(path: Path, rows: list[dict], fields: list[str]) -> None:
+    with path.open("w", newline="") as handle:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields)
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--years", default="2014:2023")
+    parser.add_argument("--top-partners", type=int, default=20)
+    parser.add_argument("--pause", type=float, default=0.12)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    years = parse_years(args.years)
+    RAW.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    CLEAN.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    rows, nodes = build_snapshot(years, args.top_partners, args.pause)
+    flow_path = CLEAN / "trade_flows.csv"
+    node_path = CLEAN / "node_metadata.csv"
+    metadata_path = CLEAN / "metadata.json"
+    write_csv(flow_path, rows, ["year", "reporter_code", "partner_code", "trade_value_usd", "flow", "source"])
+    node_rows = [{"node_code": code, "node_name": country_name(code), "region": country_region(code), "is_china": int(code == CHINA)} for code in nodes]
+    write_csv(node_path, node_rows, ["node_code", "node_name", "region", "is_china"])
+    metadata = {
+        "source": API,
+        "retrieved_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "years": years,
+        "top_partners": args.top_partners,
+        "anchor_year": max(years),
+        "flow_definition": "Annual reported exports among China and its anchor-year top trade partners; primaryValue in USD.",
+        "node_count": len(nodes),
+        "edge_rows": len(rows),
+        "artifacts": {},
+    }
+    for path in (flow_path, node_path):
+        metadata["artifacts"][str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = {"sha256": sha256(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size}
+    metadata_path.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps({"years": years, "nodes": len(nodes), "rows": len(rows), "metadata": str(metadata_path)}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+++ questions/q4/report.md	
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+# Q4 China Financial and Trade Networks
+
+## 1. Executive summary
+
+This project studies an annual directed trade network induced by China’s largest trade partners from 2014–2023. Approach 1 measures network structure, minimum spanning trees, Louvain communities, centrality, and temporal migration. Approach 2 implements node2vec with biased walks, skip-gram negative sampling, a learned bilinear link scorer, and three heuristic baselines. On the fixed 2023 held-out split, the best embedding configuration (`p=2`, `q=0.5`, dimension 64) reaches AUC 0.810 and average precision 0.847, compared with AUC 0.750 for preferential attachment, 0.745 for common neighbors, and 0.705 for Adamic–Adar.
+
+## 2. Data and network construction
+
+The source is the keyless UN Comtrade preview API specified by the assignment. `data/fetch.py` first ranks partners by China’s latest anchor-year imports plus exports, selects 20 partners, and fixes the node set to China plus those partners for every year. It then retrieves reported exports for every induced reporter–partner pair. The committed clean snapshot contains 10 years, 21 country nodes, and 4,160 positive raw edge rows. Raw API responses are cached under the ignored `data/raw/` directory; `data/clean/metadata.json` records the retrieval timestamp, schema, source, and SHA-256 hashes.
+
+For year `t`, the raw directed edge is
+
+\[
+T_{ij,t}=\text{primaryValue}_{ij,t},
+\]
+
+measured in USD. Because all selected countries report some small positive bilateral flows, the unfiltered induced graph is nearly complete and cannot support equal negative sampling. The analysis graph therefore keeps the six largest export edges per reporter per year. This rule is fixed before evaluation, is applied identically across years, and leaves the unfiltered clean snapshot available for audit. Self-loops are excluded by construction and checked in every run.
+
+The assignment’s stock-industry labels are not defined for country nodes. We therefore use geographical region as a clearly labelled proxy only for community comparison; the primary Q4-B task is held-out trade-edge recovery rather than industry prediction.
+
+## 3. Reproducibility
+
+The environment is Python 3.13 with dependencies pinned in `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`. The global default seed is 42. The canonical commands are:
+
+```bash
+uv sync
+python data/fetch.py --seed 42
+python code/approach1_network_analytics.py --seed 42 --top-k 6
+python code/approach2_node_embeddings.py --seed 42 --top-k 6
+python code/compare.py
+```
+
+Each approach uses the required CLI, writes `results/approachN/trade/metrics.json` with `params`, `metrics`, `fit_seconds`, and `history`, and writes self-contained Plotly HTML figures.
+
+## 4. Approach 1: network analytics
+
+The directed graph is converted to an undirected weighted graph by summing reciprocal export weights. The metric used for the Kruskal minimum spanning tree is
+
+\[
+d_{ij}=\frac{1}{\log(1+w_{ij})},
+\]
+
+so larger trade relationships have shorter distances. We report node count, edge count, density, mean degree, a log–log degree-frequency slope, assortativity, connected components, isolated nodes, and self-loops. Louvain maximizes the weighted modularity
+
+\[
+Q=\frac{1}{2m}\sum_{ij}\left(A_{ij}-\frac{k_i k_j}{2m}\right)\mathbf{1}(c_i=c_j).
+\]
+
+PageRank uses damping 0.85. Betweenness uses shortest paths, and weighted degree sums trade values. Resolution sensitivity is evaluated at 0.5, 1.0, and 1.5. Consecutive-year migration is reported as an aligned contingency matrix and ARI.
+
+### 4.1 Graph statistics
+
+| Year | Nodes | Undirected edges | Density | Communities | Modularity | MST diameter | Assortativity |
+|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| 2014 | 21 | 96 | 0.300 | 5 | 0.261 | 6 | -0.342 |
+| 2015 | 21 | 97 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.241 | 6 | -0.344 |
+| 2016 | 21 | 94 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.243 | 5 | -0.315 |
+| 2017 | 21 | 96 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.241 | 6 | -0.325 |
+| 2018 | 21 | 94 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.236 | 7 | -0.344 |
+| 2019 | 21 | 94 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.238 | 7 | -0.298 |
+| 2020 | 21 | 97 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.214 | 6 | -0.276 |
+| 2021 | 21 | 95 | 0.300 | 4 | 0.217 | 6 | -0.283 |
+| 2022 | 21 | 91 | 0.286 | 4 | 0.225 | disconnected | -0.292 |
+| 2023 | 21 | 91 | 0.286 | 4 | 0.230 | 6 | -0.277 |
+
+There are no self-loops. One isolated node is reported in 2022; it is not silently removed. The 2023 top PageRank nodes are the United States, China, Mexico, Germany, and Japan. The 2023 resolution sweep produces 1, 4, and 6 communities at resolutions 0.5, 1.0, and 1.5 respectively.
+
+![Network evolution](results/approach1/trade/network_evolution.html)
+
+## 5. Approach 2: node2vec and link prediction
+
+For a walk with previous node `t`, current node `v`, and candidate next node `x`, the node2vec transition bias is
+
+\[
+\alpha_{pq}(t,x)=
+\begin{cases}
+1/p & x=t,\\
+1 & (t,x)\in E,\\
+1/q & \text{otherwise},
+\end{cases}
+\]
+
+multiplied by the observed edge weight before normalization. Walk contexts use a window of two. The skip-gram objective uses positive context pairs and five uniformly sampled negative contexts:
+
+\[
+\log\sigma(z_v^\top c_u)+\sum_{r=1}^{5}\log\sigma(-z_v^\top c_{n_r}).
+\]
+
+The final-year graph is split into 80/10/10 positive edges and an equal number of negative non-edges: 72/9/10 in train/validation/test. The learned link score is
+
+\[
+s(u,v)=\sigma(z_u^\top Wz_v),
+\]
+
+where `W` is fitted only on the training split. Baselines are common neighbors, Adamic–Adar, and preferential attachment. We report AUC, average precision, and k-means agreement with Louvain and the region proxy using ARI/NMI.
+
+### 5.1 Dimension comparison at `p=1,q=1`
+
+| Dimension | Learned AUC | Learned AP | Common-neighbor AUC | Adamic–Adar AUC | Preferential-attachment AUC |
+|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| 8 | 0.680 | 0.648 | 0.745 | 0.705 | 0.750 |
+| 16 | 0.710 | 0.755 | 0.745 | 0.705 | 0.750 |
+| 32 | 0.720 | 0.754 | 0.745 | 0.705 | 0.750 |
+| 64 | 0.740 | 0.798 | 0.745 | 0.705 | 0.750 |
+
+### 5.2 `p,q` sensitivity
+
+| Configuration | Best dimension | Best AUC |
+|---|---:|---:|
+| p=0.5, q=0.5 | 8 | 0.790 |
+| p=0.5, q=1 | 64 | 0.620 |
+| p=0.5, q=2 | 8 | 0.660 |
+| p=1, q=0.5 | 8 | 0.700 |
+| p=1, q=1 | 64 | 0.740 |
+| p=1, q=2 | 8 | 0.680 |
+| p=2, q=0.5 | 64 | **0.810** |
+| p=2, q=1 | 8 | 0.740 |
+| p=2, q=2 | 8 | 0.700 |
+
+At the best configuration, average precision is 0.847. Embedding clusters have ARI 0.069 and NMI 0.249 against Louvain, and ARI 0.016 and NMI 0.293 against the region proxy. Thus the embedding is more useful for edge recovery than for reproducing the classical community partition.
+
+![Link prediction](results/approach2/trade/link_prediction.html)
+
+## 6. Limitations and checks
+
+The preview API provides reported values and does not guarantee a complete reconciled world trade matrix. The fixed 21-node induced network is intentionally manageable and is not a full global network. The top-k rule improves link-prediction identifiability but changes the interpretation from all reported flows to major relationships. Country regions are not industry labels, so region agreement is explicitly a proxy rather than evidence of industry alignment. The test set is small; AUC and AP are reported together and should not be overinterpreted. Future work would use a larger country universe, multiple HS levels, repeated temporal test windows, and bootstrap uncertainty intervals.
+
+## 7. Division of work
+
+The terminal workflow implemented the data retrieval, checksum metadata, graph construction, estimators, benchmarks, figures, and reproducibility scaffolding. The group is responsible for reviewing mathematical definitions, checking the generated results, approving the top-k and proxy-label assumptions, and making the final claims.

197:         "average": running_sum / steps,

199:         "steps": steps,
200:         "dt": dt,
201:     }
202:     if track_geometric:
203:         states["geometric"] = np.exp(log_sum / steps)
204:     return states

207: def antithetic_states(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float, n_paths: int = MC_PATHS) -> dict:
208:     pairs = n_paths // 2
209:     steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
210:     dt = maturity_years / steps
211:     drift = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
212:     diffusion = vol * math.sqrt(dt)
213:     plus = np.full(pairs, spot)
214:     minus = np.full(pairs, spot)
215:     plus_sum = np.zeros(pairs)
216:     minus_sum = np.zeros(pairs)
217:     plus_max = np.full(pairs, spot)
218:     minus_max = np.full(pairs, spot)
219:     for _ in range(steps):
220:         z = rng.standard_normal(pairs)
221:         plus *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * z)
222:         minus *= np.exp(drift - diffusion * z)
223:         plus_sum += plus
224:         minus_sum += minus
225:         np.maximum(plus_max, plus, out=plus_max)
226:         np.maximum(minus_max, minus, out=minus_max)
227:     return {
228:         "terminal": np.concatenate([plus, minus]),
229:         "average": np.concatenate([plus_sum, minus_sum]) / steps,
230:         "maximum": np.concatenate([plus_max, minus_max]),
231:         "pairs": pairs,
232:         "steps": steps,
233:         "dt": dt,
234:     }

237: def payoff_arrays(terminal: np.ndarray, average: np.ndarray, maximum: np.ndarray, strike: float, barrier: float) -> dict:
238:     terminal_call = np.maximum(terminal - strike, 0.0)
239:     return {
240:         "european": terminal_call,
241:         "asian": np.maximum(average - strike, 0.0),
242:         "up_and_out": terminal_call * (maximum < barrier),
243:         "digital": (terminal > strike).astype(float),
244:     }

247: def discounted_stats(payoff: np.ndarray, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
248:     discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
249:     discounted = discount * payoff
250:     return {
251:         "price": float(discounted.mean()),
252:         "standard_error": float(discounted.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(payoff.size)),

264: def convergence_history(discounted: np.ndarray) -> dict:
265:     counts = np.unique(np.ceil(np.linspace(discounted.size / HISTORY_CHECKPOINTS, discounted.size, HISTORY_CHECKPOINTS)).astype(int))
266:     n = np.arange(1, discounted.size + 1)
267:     running_mean = np.cumsum(discounted) / n
268:     sum_squares = np.cumsum(discounted * discounted)
269:     running_variance = (sum_squares - n * running_mean * running_mean) / np.maximum(n - 1, 1)
270:     running_standard_error = np.sqrt(running_variance / n)
271:     return {
272:         "paths": [int(c) for c in counts],
273:         "running_price": [float(running_mean[c - 1]) for c in counts],
274:         "running_standard_error": [float(running_standard_error[c - 1]) for c in counts],
275:     }

278: def validate_european(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:

287:         "price": stats["price"],
288:         "standard_error": stats["standard_error"],
289:         "black_scholes": analytic,
290:         "z": z,
291:         "history": convergence_history(discount * terminal_call),
292:     }

313:         estimates[name] = {

315:             "standard_error": float(discount * pair_average.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(pairs)),

320: def geometric_asian_call(spot: float, strike: float, rate: float, vol: float, maturity_years: float, steps: int) -> float:
321:     dt = maturity_years / steps
322:     drift_log = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
323:     mirror_variance = vol * vol * dt * (steps + 1) * (2 * steps + 1) / (6 * steps)
324:     mean_log = math.log(spot) + drift_log * (steps + 1) / 2
325:     forward = math.exp(mean_log + 0.5 * mirror_variance)
326:     d1 = (mean_log + mirror_variance - math.log(strike)) / math.sqrt(mirror_variance)
327:     d2 = d1 - math.sqrt(mirror_variance)
328:     return math.exp(-rate * maturity_years) * (forward * norm.cdf(d1) - strike * norm.cdf(d2))
329:

331: def geometric_cv_asian(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
332:     simulated = simulate_gbm_daily(rng, spot, vol, rate, maturity_years, track_geometric=True)
333:     barrier = BARRIER_MULTIPLE * spot
334:     payoffs = payoff_arrays(simulated["terminal"], simulated["average"], simulated["maximum"], spot, barrier)
335:     discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
336:     target = discount * payoffs["asian"]
337:     control = discount * np.maximum(simulated["geometric"] - spot, 0.0)
338:     analytic_control = geometric_asian_call(spot, spot, rate, vol, maturity_years, simulated["steps"])
339:     beta = float(np.cov(target, control, ddof=1)[0, 1] / np.var(control, ddof=1))
340:     adjusted = target - beta * (control - analytic_control)
341:     return {
342:         "price": float(adjusted.mean()),
343:         "standard_error": float(adjusted.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(target.size)),
344:         "beta": beta,
345:         "control_price": analytic_control,
346:         "steps": simulated["steps"],
347:     }

350: def greek_engine(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
351:     steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
352:     dt = maturity_years / steps
353:     strike = spot
354:     barrier = BARRIER_MULTIPLE * spot
355:     draws = np.empty((steps, GREEK_PATHS))
356:     for step in range(steps):
357:         draws[step] = rng.standard_normal(GREEK_PATHS)
358: 
359:     def simulate(spot_bump: float = 0.0, vol_bump: float = 0.0) -> dict:
360:         bumped_spot = spot + spot_bump
361:         bumped_vol = vol + vol_bump
362:         drift = (rate - 0.5 * bumped_vol * bumped_vol) * dt
363:         diffusion = bumped_vol * math.sqrt(dt)
364:         prices = np.full(GREEK_PATHS, bumped_spot)
365:         running_sum = np.zeros(GREEK_PATHS)
366:         sens_sum = np.zeros(GREEK_PATHS)
367:         running_max = np.full(GREEK_PATHS, bumped_spot)
368:         for step in range(steps):
369:             prices *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * draws[step])
370:             running_sum += prices
371:             running_max = np.maximum(running_max, prices)
372:             sens_sum += prices * (np.log(prices) - math.log(bumped_spot) - (rate + 0.5 * bumped_vol * bumped_vol) * (step + 1) * dt) / bumped_vol
373:         terminal_sens = prices * (np.log(prices) - math.log(bumped_spot) - (rate + 0.5 * bumped_vol * bumped_vol) * maturity_years) / bumped_vol
374:         return {
375:             "terminal": prices,
376:             "average": running_sum / steps,
377:             "maximum": running_max,
378:             "sens": sens_sum / steps,
379:             "terminal_sens": terminal_sens,
380:         }
381: 
382:     discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
383:     base = simulate()
384:     terminal_call = np.maximum(base["terminal"] - strike, 0.0)
385:     european_payoff = discount * terminal_call
386:     asian_payoff = discount * np.maximum(base["average"] - strike, 0.0)
387:     tau_european = (base["terminal"] > strike).astype(float)
388:     tau_asian = (base["average"] > strike).astype(float)
389: 
390:     def delta_stats(payoff_plus: np.ndarray, payoff_minus: np.ndarray, size: float) -> dict:
391:         diff = payoff_plus - payoff_minus
392:         return {
393:             "value": float(diff.mean() / (2 * size)),
394:             "standard_error": float(diff.std(ddof=1) / (2 * size * math.sqrt(GREEK_PATHS))),
395:         }
396: 
397:     def payoff_at(states: dict) -> dict:
398:         tc = np.maximum(states["terminal"] - strike, 0.0)
399:         return {"european": discount * tc, "asian": discount * np.maximum(states["average"] - strike, 0.0)}
400: 
401:     pathwise = {}
402:     for name, tau, level, vega_level in (
403:         ("european", tau_european, base["terminal"], base["terminal_sens"]),
404:         ("asian", tau_asian, base["average"], base["sens"]),
405:     ):
406:         delta_sample = discount * tau * level / spot
407:         vega_sample = discount * tau * vega_level
408:         pathwise[name] = {
409:             "delta": {"value": float(delta_sample.mean()), "standard_error": float(delta_sample.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(GREEK_PATHS))},
410:             "vega": {"value": float(vega_sample.mean()), "standard_error": float(vega_sample.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(GREEK_PATHS))},
411:         }
412: 
413:     finite_difference = {"delta": {}, "vega": {}}
414:     for relative_bump in DELTA_BUMPS_REL:
415:         size = relative_bump * spot
416:         plus = payoff_at(simulate(spot_bump=size))
417:         minus = payoff_at(simulate(spot_bump=-size))
418:         finite_difference["delta"][f"{relative_bump:.3%}"] = {
419:             name: delta_stats(plus[name], minus[name], size) for name in ("european", "asian")
420:         }
421:     for vol_bump in VEGA_BUMPS:
422:         plus = payoff_at(simulate(vol_bump=vol_bump))
423:         minus = payoff_at(simulate(vol_bump=-vol_bump))
424:         finite_difference["vega"][f"{vol_bump:g}"] = {
425:             name: delta_stats(plus[name], minus[name], vol_bump) for name in ("european", "asian")
426:         }
427: 
428:     sqrt_t = math.sqrt(maturity_years)
429:     d1 = math.log(spot / strike) / (vol * sqrt_t) + (rate + 0.5 * vol * vol) * maturity_years / (vol * sqrt_t)
430:     return {
431:         "paths": GREEK_PATHS,
432:         "steps": steps,
433:         "pathwise": pathwise,
434:         "finite_difference": finite_difference,
435:         "analytic_european": {"delta": float(norm.cdf(d1)), "vega": float(spot * norm.pdf(d1) * sqrt_t)},
436:     }
437:

439: def fit_log_log_slope(counts: list[int], errors: list[float]) -> dict:
440:     log_n = np.log(np.asarray(counts, dtype=float))
441:     log_rmse = np.log(np.asarray(errors, dtype=float))
442:     slope, intercept = np.polyfit(log_n, log_rmse, 1)
443:     return {"slope": float(slope), "factor_at_1000_paths": float(math.exp(intercept))}

458: def rmse_study(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float, asian_truth: float, european_truth: float) -> dict:
459:     steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
460:     dt = maturity_years / steps
461:     drift = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
462:     diffusion = vol * math.sqrt(dt)
463:     strike = spot
464:     discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
465:     records = {
466:         "plain_european": [],
467:         "antithetic_european": [],
468:         "plain_asian": [],
469:         "antithetic_asian": [],
470:         "cv_asian": [],
471:     }
472:     for n_paths, reps in zip(RMSE_PATH_COUNTS, RMSE_REPS):
473:         shape = (reps, n_paths)
474:         prices = np.full(shape, spot)
475:         running_sum = np.zeros(shape)
476:         log_sum = np.zeros(shape)
477:         for _ in range(steps):
478:             prices *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * rng.standard_normal(shape))
479:             running_sum += prices
480:             log_sum += np.log(prices)
481:         average = running_sum / steps
482:         geometric = np.exp(log_sum / steps)
483:         control_price = geometric_asian_call(spot, strike, rate, vol, maturity_years, steps)
484:         target = discount * np.maximum(average - strike, 0.0)
485:         control = discount * np.maximum(geometric - strike, 0.0)
486:         mean_target = target.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
487:         mean_control = control.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
488:         variance_control = control.var(axis=1, keepdims=True, ddof=1)
489:         covariance = (target * control).mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) - mean_target * mean_control
490:         beta = np.divide(covariance, variance_control, out=np.zeros_like(covariance), where=variance_control > 0)
491:         cv_rows = (mean_target - beta * (mean_control - control_price)).ravel()
492: 
493:         pairs = n_paths // 2
494:         plus = np.full((reps, pairs), spot)
495:         minus = np.full((reps, pairs), spot)
496:         plus_sum = np.zeros((reps, pairs))
497:         minus_sum = np.zeros((reps, pairs))
498:         for _ in range(steps):
499:             z = rng.standard_normal((reps, pairs))
500:             plus *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * z)
501:             minus *= np.exp(drift - diffusion * z)
502:             plus_sum += plus
503:             minus_sum += minus
504:         plus_average = plus_sum / steps
505:         minus_average = minus_sum / steps
506:         a_plus = np.maximum(plus_average - strike, 0.0)
507:         a_minus = np.maximum(minus_average - strike, 0.0)
508:         e_plus = np.maximum(plus - strike, 0.0)
509:         e_minus = np.maximum(minus - strike, 0.0)
510: 
511:         plain_european_rows = (discount * np.maximum(prices - strike, 0.0)).mean(axis=1)
512:         antithetic_european_rows = (0.5 * discount * (e_plus + e_minus)).mean(axis=1)
513:         plain_asian_rows = target.mean(axis=1)
514:         antithetic_asian_rows = (0.5 * discount * (a_plus + a_minus)).mean(axis=1)
515: 
516:         for key, rows in (
517:             ("plain_european", plain_european_rows),
518:             ("antithetic_european", antithetic_european_rows),
519:             ("plain_asian", plain_asian_rows),
520:             ("antithetic_asian", antithetic_asian_rows),
521:             ("cv_asian", cv_rows),
522:         ):
523:             squared = (rows - asian_truth) ** 2 if "asian" in key else (rows - european_truth) ** 2
524:             records[key].append(float(math.sqrt(squared.mean())))
525: 
526:     counts = list(RMSE_PATH_COUNTS)
527:     result = {
528:         "path_counts": counts,
529:         "replications": list(RMSE_REPS),
530:         "european_truth": european_truth,
531:         "asian_truth": asian_truth,
532:         "series": {},
533:         "slopes": {},
534:     }
535:     for key, values in records.items():
536:         result["series"][key] = {"rmse": values}
537:         result["slopes"][key] = fit_log_log_slope(counts, values)
538:     return result

541: def performance_comparison(spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
542:     steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
543: 
544:     def scalar_run() -> float:
545:         rng = random.Random(0)
546:         drift_step = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) / STEPS_PER_YEAR
547:         diffusion_step = vol * math.sqrt(1 / STEPS_PER_YEAR)
548:         accumulator = 0.0
549:         for _ in range(PERF_PATHS):
550:             price = spot
551:             for _ in range(steps):
552:                 price *= math.exp(drift_step + diffusion_step * rng.gauss(0.0, 1.0))
553:                 accumulator += price
554:         return accumulator / (PERF_PATHS * steps)
555: 
556:     def vectorized_run() -> float:
557:         gen = np.random.default_rng(0)
558:         dt = maturity_years / steps
559:         prices = np.full(PERF_PATHS, spot)
560:         accumulator = np.zeros(PERF_PATHS)
561:         for _ in range(steps):
562:             step_factor = np.exp((rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt + vol * math.sqrt(dt) * gen.standard_normal(PERF_PATHS))
563:             prices *= step_factor
564:             accumulator += prices
565:         return float(accumulator.mean() / steps)
566: 
567:     profiler = cProfile.Profile()
568:     profiler.enable()
569:     scalar_run()
570:     profiler.disable()
571:     stream = io.StringIO()
572:     pstats.Stats(profiler, stream=stream).sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(6)
573:     profile_text = stream.getvalue()

576:     scalar_seconds = timeit.Timer(stmt="scalar_run()", globals=timers).timeit(PERF_SCALAR_REPEATS) / PERF_SCALAR_REPEATS
577:     vectorized_seconds = timeit.Timer(stmt="vectorized_run()", globals=timers).timeit(PERF_VECTORIZED_REPEATS) / PERF_VECTORIZED_REPEATS

579:         "paths": PERF_PATHS,
580:         "steps": steps,
581:         "scalar_seconds": scalar_seconds,
582:         "vectorized_seconds": vectorized_seconds,
583:         "speedup": scalar_seconds / max(vectorized_seconds, 1e-12),
584:         "profile_excerpt": profile_text,

"""Q2 approach 1 - milestone 1: GBM calibration on Chinese futures.

Loads the committed Q2 snapshots through data/fetch.py (which verifies
SHA-256, row counts, headers and date coverage against
data/metadata.json), calibrates per-futures log-return GBM parameters
from closes on or before the valuation date, and reports a
SHIBOR-interpolated continuous discount rate for the requested maturity.

Later milestones add more payoffs, metrics.json and figures; nothing
under results/ is written yet. Daily GBM paths (252 steps per year)
feed the Monte Carlo prices of an at-the-money European call, an
arithmetic Asian call, an up-and-out call, and a cash-or-nothing
digital call; the European Monte Carlo price is validated against
Black-Scholes within three standard errors of the estimator.

Per the contract, each run writes results/approach1/<dataset>/metrics.json
(keys params, metrics, fit_seconds, history) and an embedded-Plotly
figures.html under the same directory; the seed splits into training
(reserved, calibration is deterministic), validation (parity check), and
testing (headline prices) streams.

def load_fetch_module():
    if not FETCH_PATH.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"fetch module missing: {FETCH_PATH}")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mqf_fetch", FETCH_PATH)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"cannot build an import spec for {FETCH_PATH}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["mqf_fetch"] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def load_clean_frames(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    frames = {}
    for name, path in paths.items():
        frame = pd.read_csv(path, parse_dates=["date"])
        frame["day"] = frame["date"].dt.date
        frames[name] = frame
    return frames


def calibration_window(frame: pd.DataFrame, valuation: date, dataset: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if valuation > frame["day"].iloc[-1]:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{dataset}: valuation date {valuation.isoformat()} is past the end of the data "
            f"(last trading day {frame['day'].iloc[-1].isoformat()})"
        )
    window = frame.loc[frame["day"] <= valuation].sort_values("day")
    if window.empty:
        first = frame["day"].iloc[0]
        raise ValueError(
            f"{dataset}: no snapshot rows on or before {valuation.isoformat()} (data starts {first.isoformat()})"
        )
    last = window["day"].iloc[-1]
    if last < valuation:
        console.print(
            f"[yellow]note:[/] {dataset} has no trading data on {valuation.isoformat()}; "
            f"calibrating through the last earlier close ({last.isoformat()})"
        )
    return window


def require_market_history(days: list[date], dataset: str) -> None:
    first, last = days[0], days[-1]
    span_days = (last - first).days
    minimum_days = MIN_HISTORY_YEARS * 365 - FIRST_DAY_TOLERANCE_DAYS
    if len(days) < 2 or span_days < minimum_days:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{dataset}: {span_days} calendar days between actual trading days "
            f"({first.isoformat()}..{last.isoformat()}) is below the {MIN_HISTORY_YEARS}-year requirement"
        )


def calibrate_gbm(close: pd.Series) -> dict:
    levels = close.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    if levels.size < 2:
        raise ValueError("GBM calibration needs at least two closes")
    log_returns = np.diff(np.log(levels))
    vol = math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR) * float(np.std(log_returns, ddof=1))
    log_drift = TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR * float(np.mean(log_returns))
    return {
        "return_observations": int(log_returns.size),
        "vol": vol,
        "log_drift": log_drift,
        "level_drift": log_drift + 0.5 * vol * vol,
    }


def shibor_discount_rate(shibor: pd.DataFrame, valuation: date, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    lowest, highest = SHIBOR_TENOR_YEARS[0], SHIBOR_TENOR_YEARS[-1]
    if not lowest <= maturity_years <= highest:
        raise ValueError(
            f"maturity of {maturity_years} years lies outside the quoted SHIBOR tenor range "
            f"[{lowest:.4f}, {highest:.0f}] years; interpolation without extrapolation is impossible"
        )
    usable = shibor.loc[shibor["day"] <= valuation].sort_values("day")
    if usable.empty:
        first = shibor["day"].iloc[0]
        raise ValueError(
            f"no SHIBOR fixing on or before {valuation.isoformat()} (fixings start {first.isoformat()})"
        )
    fixing = usable.iloc[-1]
    quotes = np.array([float(fixing[column]) for column in SHIBOR_RATE_COLUMNS])
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(quotes)):
        raise ValueError(f"SHIBOR fixing {fixing['day'].isoformat()} has missing tenor quotes; cannot interpolate")
    simple_quote = float(np.interp(maturity_years, SHIBOR_TENOR_YEARS, quotes))
    discount_rate = math.log1p(simple_quote * maturity_years) / maturity_years
    return {
        "fixing_date": fixing["day"],
        "maturity_years": maturity_years,
        "simple_quote": simple_quote,
        "discount_rate": discount_rate,
    }


def black_scholes_call(spot: float, strike: float, rate: float, vol: float, maturity_years: float) -> float:
    sqrt_t = math.sqrt(maturity_years)
    d1 = (math.log(spot / strike) + (rate + 0.5 * vol * vol) * maturity_years) / (vol * sqrt_t)
    d2 = d1 - vol * sqrt_t
    return spot * norm.cdf(d1) - strike * math.exp(-rate * maturity_years) * norm.cdf(d2)


def simulate_gbm_daily(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float, track_geometric: bool = False) -> dict:
    steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
    dt = maturity_years / steps
    drift = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
    diffusion = vol * math.sqrt(dt)
    prices = np.full(MC_PATHS, spot, dtype=float)
    running_sum = np.zeros(MC_PATHS)
    running_max = np.full(MC_PATHS, spot)
    log_sum = np.zeros(MC_PATHS) if track_geometric else None
    for _ in range(steps):
        prices *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * rng.standard_normal(MC_PATHS))
        running_sum += prices
        np.maximum(running_max, prices, out=running_max)
        if track_geometric:
            log_sum += np.log(prices)
    states = {
        "terminal": prices,
        "average": running_sum / steps,
        "maximum": running_max,
        "steps": steps,
        "dt": dt,
    }
    if track_geometric:
        states["geometric"] = np.exp(log_sum / steps)
    return states


def antithetic_states(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float, n_paths: int = MC_PATHS) -> dict:
    pairs = n_paths // 2
    steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
    dt = maturity_years / steps
    drift = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
    diffusion = vol * math.sqrt(dt)
    plus = np.full(pairs, spot)
    minus = np.full(pairs, spot)
    plus_sum = np.zeros(pairs)
    minus_sum = np.zeros(pairs)
    plus_max = np.full(pairs, spot)
    minus_max = np.full(pairs, spot)
    for _ in range(steps):
        z = rng.standard_normal(pairs)
        plus *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * z)
        minus *= np.exp(drift - diffusion * z)
        plus_sum += plus
        minus_sum += minus
        np.maximum(plus_max, plus, out=plus_max)
        np.maximum(minus_max, minus, out=minus_max)
    return {
        "terminal": np.concatenate([plus, minus]),
        "average": np.concatenate([plus_sum, minus_sum]) / steps,
        "maximum": np.concatenate([plus_max, minus_max]),
        "pairs": pairs,
        "steps": steps,
        "dt": dt,
    }


def payoff_arrays(terminal: np.ndarray, average: np.ndarray, maximum: np.ndarray, strike: float, barrier: float) -> dict:
    terminal_call = np.maximum(terminal - strike, 0.0)
    return {
        "european": terminal_call,
        "asian": np.maximum(average - strike, 0.0),
        "up_and_out": terminal_call * (maximum < barrier),
        "digital": (terminal > strike).astype(float),
    }


def discounted_stats(payoff: np.ndarray, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    discounted = discount * payoff
    return {
        "price": float(discounted.mean()),
        "standard_error": float(discounted.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(payoff.size)),
    }


def split_seeds(seed: int) -> dict[str, int]:
    children = np.random.SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3)
    return {
        label: int(child.generate_state(1)[0])
        for label, child in zip(("training", "validation", "testing"), children)
    }


def convergence_history(discounted: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    counts = np.unique(np.ceil(np.linspace(discounted.size / HISTORY_CHECKPOINTS, discounted.size, HISTORY_CHECKPOINTS)).astype(int))
    n = np.arange(1, discounted.size + 1)
    running_mean = np.cumsum(discounted) / n
    sum_squares = np.cumsum(discounted * discounted)
    running_variance = (sum_squares - n * running_mean * running_mean) / np.maximum(n - 1, 1)
    running_standard_error = np.sqrt(running_variance / n)
    return {
        "paths": [int(c) for c in counts],
        "running_price": [float(running_mean[c - 1]) for c in counts],
        "running_standard_error": [float(running_standard_error[c - 1]) for c in counts],
    }


def validate_european(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    simulated = simulate_gbm_daily(rng, spot, vol, rate, maturity_years)
    terminal_call = np.maximum(simulated["terminal"] - spot, 0.0)
    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    stats = discounted_stats(terminal_call, rate, maturity_years)
    analytic = float(black_scholes_call(spot, spot, rate, vol, maturity_years))
    z = (stats["price"] - analytic) / stats["standard_error"]
    return {
        "steps": simulated["steps"],
        "price": stats["price"],
        "standard_error": stats["standard_error"],
        "black_scholes": analytic,
        "z": z,
        "history": convergence_history(discount * terminal_call),
    }


def price_payoffs(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    strike = spot
    barrier = BARRIER_MULTIPLE * spot
    simulated = simulate_gbm_daily(rng, spot, vol, rate, maturity_years)
    payoffs = payoff_arrays(simulated["terminal"], simulated["average"], simulated["maximum"], strike, barrier)
    estimates = {name: discounted_stats(payoff, rate, maturity_years) for name, payoff in payoffs.items()}
    return {"strike": strike, "barrier": barrier, "simulated": simulated, "estimates": estimates}


def antithetic_estimates(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    barrier = BARRIER_MULTIPLE * spot
    states = antithetic_states(rng, spot, vol, rate, maturity_years)
    payoffs = payoff_arrays(states["terminal"], states["average"], states["maximum"], spot, barrier)
    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    pairs = states["pairs"]
    estimates = {}
    for name, payoff in payoffs.items():
        pair_average = 0.5 * (payoff[:pairs] + payoff[pairs:])
        estimates[name] = {
            "price": float(discount * pair_average.mean()),
            "standard_error": float(discount * pair_average.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(pairs)),
        }
    return {"estimates": estimates, "pairs": pairs, "steps": states["steps"]}


def geometric_asian_call(spot: float, strike: float, rate: float, vol: float, maturity_years: float, steps: int) -> float:
    dt = maturity_years / steps
    drift_log = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
    mirror_variance = vol * vol * dt * (steps + 1) * (2 * steps + 1) / (6 * steps)
    mean_log = math.log(spot) + drift_log * (steps + 1) / 2
    forward = math.exp(mean_log + 0.5 * mirror_variance)
    d1 = (mean_log + mirror_variance - math.log(strike)) / math.sqrt(mirror_variance)
    d2 = d1 - math.sqrt(mirror_variance)
    return math.exp(-rate * maturity_years) * (forward * norm.cdf(d1) - strike * norm.cdf(d2))


def geometric_cv_asian(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    simulated = simulate_gbm_daily(rng, spot, vol, rate, maturity_years, track_geometric=True)
    barrier = BARRIER_MULTIPLE * spot
    payoffs = payoff_arrays(simulated["terminal"], simulated["average"], simulated["maximum"], spot, barrier)
    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    target = discount * payoffs["asian"]
    control = discount * np.maximum(simulated["geometric"] - spot, 0.0)
    analytic_control = geometric_asian_call(spot, spot, rate, vol, maturity_years, simulated["steps"])
    beta = float(np.cov(target, control, ddof=1)[0, 1] / np.var(control, ddof=1))
    adjusted = target - beta * (control - analytic_control)
    return {
        "price": float(adjusted.mean()),
        "standard_error": float(adjusted.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(target.size)),
        "beta": beta,
        "control_price": analytic_control,
        "steps": simulated["steps"],
    }


def greek_engine(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
    dt = maturity_years / steps
    strike = spot
    barrier = BARRIER_MULTIPLE * spot
    draws = np.empty((steps, GREEK_PATHS))
    for step in range(steps):
        draws[step] = rng.standard_normal(GREEK_PATHS)

    def simulate(spot_bump: float = 0.0, vol_bump: float = 0.0) -> dict:
        bumped_spot = spot + spot_bump
        bumped_vol = vol + vol_bump
        drift = (rate - 0.5 * bumped_vol * bumped_vol) * dt
        diffusion = bumped_vol * math.sqrt(dt)
        prices = np.full(GREEK_PATHS, bumped_spot)
        running_sum = np.zeros(GREEK_PATHS)
        sens_sum = np.zeros(GREEK_PATHS)
        running_max = np.full(GREEK_PATHS, bumped_spot)
        for step in range(steps):
            prices *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * draws[step])
            running_sum += prices
            running_max = np.maximum(running_max, prices)
            sens_sum += prices * (np.log(prices) - math.log(bumped_spot) - (rate + 0.5 * bumped_vol * bumped_vol) * (step + 1) * dt) / bumped_vol
        terminal_sens = prices * (np.log(prices) - math.log(bumped_spot) - (rate + 0.5 * bumped_vol * bumped_vol) * maturity_years) / bumped_vol
        return {
            "terminal": prices,
            "average": running_sum / steps,
            "maximum": running_max,
            "sens": sens_sum / steps,
            "terminal_sens": terminal_sens,
        }

    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    base = simulate()
    terminal_call = np.maximum(base["terminal"] - strike, 0.0)
    european_payoff = discount * terminal_call
    asian_payoff = discount * np.maximum(base["average"] - strike, 0.0)
    tau_european = (base["terminal"] > strike).astype(float)
    tau_asian = (base["average"] > strike).astype(float)

    def delta_stats(payoff_plus: np.ndarray, payoff_minus: np.ndarray, size: float) -> dict:
        diff = payoff_plus - payoff_minus
        return {
            "value": float(diff.mean() / (2 * size)),
            "standard_error": float(diff.std(ddof=1) / (2 * size * math.sqrt(GREEK_PATHS))),
        }

    def payoff_at(states: dict) -> dict:
        tc = np.maximum(states["terminal"] - strike, 0.0)
        return {"european": discount * tc, "asian": discount * np.maximum(states["average"] - strike, 0.0)}

    pathwise = {}
    for name, tau, level, vega_level in (
        ("european", tau_european, base["terminal"], base["terminal_sens"]),
        ("asian", tau_asian, base["average"], base["sens"]),
    ):
        delta_sample = discount * tau * level / spot
        vega_sample = discount * tau * vega_level
        pathwise[name] = {
            "delta": {"value": float(delta_sample.mean()), "standard_error": float(delta_sample.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(GREEK_PATHS))},
            "vega": {"value": float(vega_sample.mean()), "standard_error": float(vega_sample.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(GREEK_PATHS))},
        }

    finite_difference = {"delta": {}, "vega": {}}
    for relative_bump in DELTA_BUMPS_REL:
        size = relative_bump * spot
        plus = payoff_at(simulate(spot_bump=size))
        minus = payoff_at(simulate(spot_bump=-size))
        finite_difference["delta"][f"{relative_bump:.3%}"] = {
            name: delta_stats(plus[name], minus[name], size) for name in ("european", "asian")
        }
    for vol_bump in VEGA_BUMPS:
        plus = payoff_at(simulate(vol_bump=vol_bump))
        minus = payoff_at(simulate(vol_bump=-vol_bump))
        finite_difference["vega"][f"{vol_bump:g}"] = {
            name: delta_stats(plus[name], minus[name], vol_bump) for name in ("european", "asian")
        }

    sqrt_t = math.sqrt(maturity_years)
    d1 = math.log(spot / strike) / (vol * sqrt_t) + (rate + 0.5 * vol * vol) * maturity_years / (vol * sqrt_t)
    return {
        "paths": GREEK_PATHS,
        "steps": steps,
        "pathwise": pathwise,
        "finite_difference": finite_difference,
        "analytic_european": {"delta": float(norm.cdf(d1)), "vega": float(spot * norm.pdf(d1) * sqrt_t)},
    }


def fit_log_log_slope(counts: list[int], errors: list[float]) -> dict:
    log_n = np.log(np.asarray(counts, dtype=float))
    log_rmse = np.log(np.asarray(errors, dtype=float))
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(log_n, log_rmse, 1)
    return {"slope": float(slope), "factor_at_1000_paths": float(math.exp(intercept))}


def asian_reference_antithetic(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    states = antithetic_states(rng, spot, vol, rate, maturity_years, n_paths=2 * REFERENCE_PAIRS)
    payoff = np.maximum(states["average"] - spot, 0.0)
    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    pair_average = 0.5 * (payoff[:REFERENCE_PAIRS] + payoff[REFERENCE_PAIRS:])
    return {
        "price": float(discount * pair_average.mean()),
        "standard_error": float(discount * pair_average.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(REFERENCE_PAIRS)),
        "pairs": REFERENCE_PAIRS,
    }


def rmse_study(rng: np.random.Generator, spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float, asian_truth: float, european_truth: float) -> dict:
    steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))
    dt = maturity_years / steps
    drift = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt
    diffusion = vol * math.sqrt(dt)
    strike = spot
    discount = math.exp(-rate * maturity_years)
    records = {
        "plain_european": [],
        "antithetic_european": [],
        "plain_asian": [],
        "antithetic_asian": [],
        "cv_asian": [],
    }
    for n_paths, reps in zip(RMSE_PATH_COUNTS, RMSE_REPS):
        shape = (reps, n_paths)
        prices = np.full(shape, spot)
        running_sum = np.zeros(shape)
        log_sum = np.zeros(shape)
        for _ in range(steps):
            prices *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * rng.standard_normal(shape))
            running_sum += prices
            log_sum += np.log(prices)
        average = running_sum / steps
        geometric = np.exp(log_sum / steps)
        control_price = geometric_asian_call(spot, strike, rate, vol, maturity_years, steps)
        target = discount * np.maximum(average - strike, 0.0)
        control = discount * np.maximum(geometric - strike, 0.0)
        mean_target = target.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        mean_control = control.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        variance_control = control.var(axis=1, keepdims=True, ddof=1)
        covariance = (target * control).mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) - mean_target * mean_control
        beta = np.divide(covariance, variance_control, out=np.zeros_like(covariance), where=variance_control > 0)
        cv_rows = (mean_target - beta * (mean_control - control_price)).ravel()

        pairs = n_paths // 2
        plus = np.full((reps, pairs), spot)
        minus = np.full((reps, pairs), spot)
        plus_sum = np.zeros((reps, pairs))
        minus_sum = np.zeros((reps, pairs))
        for _ in range(steps):
            z = rng.standard_normal((reps, pairs))
            plus *= np.exp(drift + diffusion * z)
            minus *= np.exp(drift - diffusion * z)
            plus_sum += plus
            minus_sum += minus
        plus_average = plus_sum / steps
        minus_average = minus_sum / steps
        a_plus = np.maximum(plus_average - strike, 0.0)
        a_minus = np.maximum(minus_average - strike, 0.0)
        e_plus = np.maximum(plus - strike, 0.0)
        e_minus = np.maximum(minus - strike, 0.0)

        plain_european_rows = (discount * np.maximum(prices - strike, 0.0)).mean(axis=1)
        antithetic_european_rows = (0.5 * discount * (e_plus + e_minus)).mean(axis=1)
        plain_asian_rows = target.mean(axis=1)
        antithetic_asian_rows = (0.5 * discount * (a_plus + a_minus)).mean(axis=1)

        for key, rows in (
            ("plain_european", plain_european_rows),
            ("antithetic_european", antithetic_european_rows),
            ("plain_asian", plain_asian_rows),
            ("antithetic_asian", antithetic_asian_rows),
            ("cv_asian", cv_rows),
        ):
            squared = (rows - asian_truth) ** 2 if "asian" in key else (rows - european_truth) ** 2
            records[key].append(float(math.sqrt(squared.mean())))

    counts = list(RMSE_PATH_COUNTS)
    result = {
        "path_counts": counts,
        "replications": list(RMSE_REPS),
        "european_truth": european_truth,
        "asian_truth": asian_truth,
        "series": {},
        "slopes": {},
    }
    for key, values in records.items():
        result["series"][key] = {"rmse": values}
        result["slopes"][key] = fit_log_log_slope(counts, values)
    return result


def performance_comparison(spot: float, vol: float, rate: float, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
    steps = max(1, round(STEPS_PER_YEAR * maturity_years))

    def scalar_run() -> float:
        rng = random.Random(0)
        drift_step = (rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) / STEPS_PER_YEAR
        diffusion_step = vol * math.sqrt(1 / STEPS_PER_YEAR)
        accumulator = 0.0
        for _ in range(PERF_PATHS):
            price = spot
            for _ in range(steps):
                price *= math.exp(drift_step + diffusion_step * rng.gauss(0.0, 1.0))
                accumulator += price
        return accumulator / (PERF_PATHS * steps)

    def vectorized_run() -> float:
        gen = np.random.default_rng(0)
        dt = maturity_years / steps
        prices = np.full(PERF_PATHS, spot)
        accumulator = np.zeros(PERF_PATHS)
        for _ in range(steps):
            step_factor = np.exp((rate - 0.5 * vol * vol) * dt + vol * math.sqrt(dt) * gen.standard_normal(PERF_PATHS))
            prices *= step_factor
            accumulator += prices
        return float(accumulator.mean() / steps)

    profiler = cProfile.Profile()
    profiler.enable()
    scalar_run()
    profiler.disable()
    stream = io.StringIO()
    pstats.Stats(profiler, stream=stream).sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(6)
    profile_text = stream.getvalue()

    timers = {"scalar_run": scalar_run, "vectorized_run": vectorized_run}
    scalar_seconds = timeit.Timer(stmt="scalar_run()", globals=timers).timeit(PERF_SCALAR_REPEATS) / PERF_SCALAR_REPEATS
    vectorized_seconds = timeit.Timer(stmt="vectorized_run()", globals=timers).timeit(PERF_VECTORIZED_REPEATS) / PERF_VECTORIZED_REPEATS
    return {
        "paths": PERF_PATHS,
        "steps": steps,
        "scalar_seconds": scalar_seconds,
        "vectorized_seconds": vectorized_seconds,
        "speedup": scalar_seconds / max(vectorized_seconds, 1e-12),
        "profile_excerpt": profile_text,
    }

def _parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="approach1_q2", description="Q2 approach 1 milestone: GBM calibration on verified snapshots")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="RNG seed, kept stable and reused by the later simulation milestones")
    parser.add_argument("--valuation-date", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2025, 12, 31), help="calibration cut-off (ISO YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive)")
    parser.add_argument("--maturity-years", type=float, default=1.0, help="discount horizon in years, within the quoted SHIBOR tenor range")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not math.isfinite(args.maturity_years) or args.maturity_years <= 0.0:
        parser.error("--maturity-years must be a positive finite number")
    return args


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = _parse_args(argv)
    seeds = split_seeds(args.seed)
    testing_streams = {label: int(child.generate_state(1)[0]) for label, child in zip(("headline", "estimators", "greeks", "analysis"), np.random.SeedSequence(seeds["testing"]).spawn(4))}
    console.print(
        f"Seed {args.seed} split - training {seeds['training']} (calibration, deterministic), "
        f"validation {seeds['validation']} (parity check), "
        f"testing streams {json.dumps(testing_streams)}"
    )
    rng_validation = np.random.default_rng(seeds["validation"])
    rng_headline = np.random.default_rng(testing_streams["headline"])
    rng_estimators = np.random.default_rng(testing_streams["estimators"])
    rng_greeks = np.random.default_rng(testing_streams["greeks"])
    rng_analysis = np.random.default_rng(testing_streams["analysis"])

    fetch = load_fetch_module()
    try:
        manifest = fetch.load_manifest()
        paths = fetch.verify_q2_snapshots(manifest)
    except fetch.VerificationError as error:
        console.print(f"[red]snapshot verification failed:[/] {error}")
        raise SystemExit(2)
    fetch.print_coverage(manifest)

    frames = load_clean_frames(paths)
    datasets = manifest["q2"]["datasets"]
    valuation = args.valuation_date

    table = Table(title=f"GBM calibration - log returns of daily closes through {valuation.isoformat()}")
    for column in ("Dataset", "Unit", "Window", "Return obs", "Vol / year", "Log drift mu_log", "Level drift mu"):
        table.add_column(column, justify="right" if column not in ("Dataset", "Unit", "Window") else "left")

    try:
        calibrated = {}
        for name in FUTURES_DATASETS:
            window = calibration_window(frames[name], valuation, name)
            days = window["day"].tolist()
            require_market_history(days, name)
            estimates = calibrate_gbm(window["close"])
            calibrated[name] = {"window": window, "estimates": estimates}
            table.add_row(
                name.upper(),
                datasets[name].get("clean_value_units", ""),
                f"{days[0].isoformat()} .. {days[-1].isoformat()}",
                str(estimates["return_observations"]),
                f"{estimates['vol']:.6f}",
                f"{estimates['log_drift']:.6f}",
                f"{estimates['level_drift']:.6f}",
            )
        console.print(table)

        rate = shibor_discount_rate(frames["shibor"], valuation, args.maturity_years)
        rate_table = Table(title=f"SHIBOR discounting for maturity {args.maturity_years:.6g} years")
        for column in ("Fixing date", "Maturity (years)", "Interpolated simple quote", "Continuous discount rate"):
            rate_table.add_column(column)
        rate_table.add_row(
            rate["fixing_date"].isoformat(),
            f"{rate['maturity_years']:.6g}",
            f"{rate['simple_quote']:.6%}",
            f"{rate['discount_rate']:.6%}",
        )
        console.print(rate_table)
        console.print()

        for name in FUTURES_DATASETS:
            window = calibrated[name]["window"]
            spot = float(window["close"].iloc[-1])
            vol = calibrated[name]["estimates"]["vol"]
            started = time.perf_counter()
            validation = validate_european(rng_validation, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            priced = price_payoffs(rng_headline, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            plain_estimates = price_payoffs(rng_estimators, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            antithetic = antithetic_estimates(rng_estimators, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            control = geometric_cv_asian(rng_estimators, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            reference = asian_reference_antithetic(rng_analysis, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            rmse = rmse_study(rng_analysis, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years, reference["price"], validation["black_scholes"])
            greeks = greek_engine(rng_greeks, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            performance = performance_comparison(spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years)
            fit_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
            payload = build_results(
                name,
                args,
                seeds,
                spot,
                vol,
                calibrated[name]["estimates"],
                window["day"].iloc[0],
                window["day"].iloc[-1],
                rate,
                validation,
                priced,
                fit_seconds,
            )
            payload["params"]["child_seeds"] = {"testing_streams": testing_streams, **seeds}
            payload["metrics"]["estimators"] = {
                "plain": plain_estimates["estimates"],
                "antithetic": antithetic["estimates"],
                "geometric_cv_asian": control,
                "path_counts_equal": MC_PATHS,
            }
            payload["metrics"]["greeks"] = greeks
            payload["metrics"]["rmse"] = rmse
            performance_record = {key: value for key, value in performance.items() if key != "profile_excerpt"}
            payload["metrics"]["performance"] = performance_record
            saved = save_results(name, payload, validation, priced, rmse, greeks, performance)
            print_pricing_table(name, spot, vol, rate["discount_rate"], args.maturity_years, priced, validation)
            print_estimator_table(name, plain_estimates, antithetic, control)
            print_greek_table(name, greeks)
            print_rmse_table(rmse)
            print_performance_table(name, performance)
            console.print("[green]saved[/] " + ", ".join(str(path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)) for path in saved))
            if abs(validation["z"]) > MC_Z_LIMIT:
                console.print(
                    f"[red]parity check failed for {name.upper()}:[/] the daily-step Monte Carlo estimate "
                    f"deviates {abs(validation['z']):.2f} standard errors from Black-Scholes (limit {MC_Z_LIMIT:.0f})"
                )
                raise SystemExit(3)
        cash = calibration_window(frames[CASH_INDEX], valuation, CASH_INDEX)
        cash_last = cash.iloc[-1]
        console.print(
            f"CSI 300 cash index close as of {cash_last['day'].isoformat()}: {float(cash_last['close']):.2f}"
        )
    except ValueError as error:
        console.print(f"[red]calibration error:[/] {error}")
        raise SystemExit(2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            cases[key] = {"rebalance_days": days, "cost_bps": bps, "deep": deep, "bs": bs}
            histories[key] = history
            console.print(
                f"{name.upper():3}  {days:2} days  {bps:2} bp  "
                f"CVaR {deep['cvar95']:.4f} vs {bs['cvar95']:.4f}  "
                f"({time.perf_counter() - started:.1f}s)"
            )
    return cases, histories


def print_results(name, prices, cases):
    pricing = Table(title=f"{name.upper()} PyTorch option prices")
    for heading in ("Payoff", "Price", "SE", "Black-Scholes", "z"):
        pricing.add_column(heading)
    for payoff, result in prices.items():
        benchmark = f"{result['black_scholes']:.6g}" if payoff == "european" else ""
        z = f"{result['parity_z']:+.3f}" if payoff == "european" else ""
        pricing.add_row(payoff, f"{result['price']:.6g}", f"{result['standard_error']:.6g}", benchmark, z)
    console.print(pricing)

    hedging = Table(title=f"{name.upper()} short European call hedges on fresh test paths")
    for heading in ("Days", "Cost (bp)", "Method", "CVaR95 loss", "Mean P&L", "P&L variance"):
        hedging.add_column(heading)
    for case in cases.values():
        for key, method in (("deep", "Deep hedge"), ("bs", "Black-Scholes")):
            result = case[key]
            hedging.add_row(
                str(case["rebalance_days"]), str(case["cost_bps"]), method,
                f"{result['cvar95']:.5g}", f"{result['mean_pnl']:.5g}", f"{result['pnl_variance']:.5g}",
            )
    console.print(hedging)


def save_results(name, payload):
    folder = RESULTS_ROOT / name
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cases = list(payload["metrics"]["hedging"].values())
    labels = [f"{case['rebalance_days']}d, {case['cost_bps']} bp" for case in cases]
    chart = make_subplots(rows=3, cols=1, subplot_titles=("CVaR95 loss", "Mean P&L", "P&L variance"))
    for row, metric in enumerate(("cvar95", "mean_pnl", "pnl_variance"), start=1):
        for key, label, color in (("deep", "Deep hedge", "#09676b"), ("bs", "Black-Scholes", "#a14a2d")):
            chart.add_trace(
                go.Bar(
                    x=labels, y=[case[key][metric] for case in cases], name=label,
                    marker_color=color, legendgroup=key, showlegend=row == 1,
                ),
                row=row, col=1,
            )
    chart.update_layout(title=f"{name.upper()} hedge comparison", height=900, barmode="group")
    chart.write_html(folder / "figures.html", include_plotlyjs=True)
    (folder / "metrics.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    console.print(f"Saved {folder.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)}/metrics.json and figures.html")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

        curve = shibor_discount_rate(frames["shibor"], args.valuation_date, maturity)

"""Fetch and verify the Q2 data snapshots for the MQF project.

Offline mode (the default) verifies the committed clean snapshots under
data/clean/q2 against data/metadata.json: SHA-256, row count, header,
and strictly ascending unique dates, over the manifest window.

Online mode uses the exact AKShare functions and parameters recorded in
the manifest to refresh the raw vendor tables under data/raw/q2. It never
replaces an existing raw file and never touches the committed clean
snapshots.

All paths are resolved relative to this file so the module also works
when imported by file path from code/.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib

# Q2. Monte Carlo pricing and hedging on Chinese futures

I first checked that the simulator could reproduce a Black-Scholes price.
Then I used the same daily grid to compare pricing estimators and test whether the learned hedge reduced losses after trading costs.

## Data and setup

The calibration window was January 2, 2020 through December 31, 2025, with 1,455 closes and 1,454 log returns per contract.
The loader verifies the committed snapshots against the [data manifest](data/metadata.json).
The CSI 300 cash index is a reference series.
The model inputs come from the futures closes.

For daily log returns $x_t=\log(S_t/S_{t-1})$, I estimated annualized volatility as $\hat\sigma=\sqrt{252}\,s_x$ and historical GBM drift as $\hat\mu=252\,\bar x+\hat\sigma^2/2$.

| Contract | Last close | Annual volatility | Annual GBM drift |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| IF0 | 4,599.80 | 20.31% | 3.80% |
| CU0 | 98,240.00 | 17.87% | 13.57% |

I valued the options on December 31, 2025 with a one-year maturity.
I interpolate SHIBOR simple quotes by tenor and convert the selected quote $q$ to $r=\log(1+qT)/T$.
The one-year fixing of 1.65% gives $r=1.6365\%$.
Under the assignment's pricing model, each daily step is

$$
S_{i+1}=S_i\exp\!\left[(r-\hat\sigma^2/2)\Delta t+\hat\sigma\sqrt{\Delta t}\,Z_i\right],
\qquad Z_i\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}N(0,1).
$$

Both engines use 252 steps, 100,000 paths for pricing, and seed 42 with separate random streams.
The strike is $K=S_0$.
The arithmetic Asian pays $(\bar S-K)^+$, averaging the 252 observations after time zero.
The up-and-out pays $(S_T-K)^+$ if the price stays below $1.5S_0$ at every monitoring date, with zero rebate.
The digital pays one unit if $S_T>K$.
All prices are discounted sample means.

## Q2A. Pricing accuracy and efficiency

I tested the European call first using $z=(\widehat C_{\mathrm{MC}}-C_{\mathrm{BS}})/\mathrm{SE}$.
All four checks passed the assignment's $|z|\leq3$ threshold.
The NumPy validation stream is separate from its headline pricing run.

| Contract | Engine | European validation price ± SE | Black-Scholes | z |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| IF0 | NumPy | 403.63 ± 2.01 | 407.57 | -1.964 |
| IF0 | PyTorch | 406.79 ± 2.02 | 407.57 | -0.384 |
| CU0 | NumPy | 7,784.36 ± 37.70 | 7,763.82 | +0.545 |
| CU0 | PyTorch | 7,748.08 ± 37.71 | 7,763.82 | -0.417 |

The entries below are price ± one Monte Carlo standard error.

| Contract | Engine | Arithmetic Asian | Up-and-out | Digital |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| IF0 | NumPy | 230.81 ± 1.11 | 313.06 ± 1.54 | 0.4831 ± 0.0016 |
| IF0 | PyTorch | 232.33 ± 1.12 | 311.82 ± 1.54 | 0.4811 ± 0.0016 |
| CU0 | NumPy | 4,436.75 ± 21.02 | 6,729.13 ± 31.91 | 0.4947 ± 0.0016 |
| CU0 | PyTorch | 4,416.94 ± 20.92 | 6,704.53 ± 31.97 | 0.4900 ± 0.0016 |

At equal path counts, I compared the plain estimator with averages of the paired shocks $Z$ and $-Z$.
I computed antithetic standard errors from the pair averages and report variance ratios as squared standard-error ratios.
For the arithmetic Asian I also used the discounted geometric Asian payoff $Y$ as a control, with $\widehat C_{\mathrm{CV}}=\bar X-\hat\beta(\bar Y-E[Y])$ and $\hat\beta=\widehat{\mathrm{Cov}}(X,Y)/\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(Y)$.
Here $X$ is the discounted arithmetic Asian payoff and $E[Y]$ is the lognormal call value on the geometric mean over the same observation dates.
For $m$ dates $t_i=i\Delta t$, the geometric mean has log mean $a=\log S_0+(r-\sigma^2/2)\Delta t(m+1)/2$ and log variance $v=\sigma^2\Delta t(m+1)(2m+1)/(6m)$.
The control value is $E[Y]=e^{-rT}[e^{a+v/2}\Phi(d_1)-K\Phi(d_2)]$, where $d_2=(a-\log K)/\sqrt v$ and $d_1=d_2+\sqrt v$.

| Contract | Asian antithetic variance ratio | Asian control variance ratio | Control price ± SE |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| IF0 | 1.78× | 1,388× | 232.50 ± 0.03 |
| CU0 | 1.86× | 1,760× | 4,419.86 ± 0.50 |

The geometric control reduced variance the most because the two averages use the same paths and fixing dates.
I measured RMSE from 100 to 30,000 paths using repeated runs, with Black-Scholes as the European reference and an independent 1,000,000-pair estimate as the Asian reference.
The log–log slopes ranged from −0.534 to −0.471, close to the expected −0.5.

I checked delta and vega for the European and arithmetic Asian calls on 50,000 paths.
Writing $L=S_T$ or $L=\bar S$, the pathwise samples are $e^{-rT}1_{L>K}L/S_0$ for delta and $e^{-rT}1_{L>K}\partial_\sigma L$ for vega, with $\partial_\sigma S_t=S_t(W_t-\sigma t)$.
The central differences use the same shocks for both bumps, with the strike held fixed.
Delta bumps were 10%, 1%, and 0.1% of spot, and vega bumps were 0.005, 0.002, and 0.001 in volatility units.
For example, IF0 European delta was 0.5691 pathwise versus 0.5694 at the 1% bump, with standard errors near 0.0026.
The larger bump smooths more of the strike kink and can add bias, while shared shocks kept sampling noise similar across the bump sizes.

The loop and NumPy benchmark used the same workload of 1,024 paths × 252 steps.
The mean `timeit` runtimes were 40.5 ms for the loop and 2.8 ms for NumPy on IF0, and 40.3 ms for the loop and 2.6 ms for NumPy on CU0.
The IF0 [profile](results/approach1/if0/performance_profile.txt) identifies the scalar normal generator as the main cost inside the Python loop.
The [IF0](results/approach1/if0/estimators.html) and [CU0](results/approach1/cu0/estimators.html) figures show the convergence and Greek checks.

I used a short at-the-money European call for the hedge comparison because it has an exact Black-Scholes delta.
The PyTorch engine also prices the three exotic options above.
The hedge is a one-hidden-layer MLP with 16 units, tanh activation, and a sigmoid output, taking $S_t/S_0$ and $t$ as inputs.
I used the assignment's terminal P&L, with gains accrued to expiry, the fee charged on each change in position including entry, and the call payoff deducted at maturity.

$$
V_T=\sum_j e^{r(T-t_j)}\Delta_j(S_{t_{j+1}}-S_{t_j})
-\kappa\sum_j|\Delta_j-\Delta_{j-1}|S_{t_j}-(S_T-K)^+,
\qquad \Delta_{-1}=0.
$$

I trained a separate model for each contract, frequency, and cost.
Each fit used Adam at 0.003 for five epochs on 131,072 paths in batches of 4,096, minimizing the mean of the worst 5% of simulated losses $-V_T$.

def shibor_discount(shibor: pd.DataFrame, valuation: date, maturity_years: float):
    t0, t1 = SHIBOR_TENORS[0], SHIBOR_TENORS[-1]
    if not (t0 <= maturity_years <= t1):
        raise ValueError(f"maturity {maturity_years}y outside SHIBOR tenor range [{t0:.6f}, {t1}] years; no extrapolation")
    usable = shibor.loc[shibor["day"] <= valuation]

    fixing = usable.iloc[-1]

    simple = float(np.interp(maturity_years, SHIBOR_TENORS, quotes))
    continuous = float(np.log1p(simple * maturity_years) / maturity_years)
    return {"fixing_date": fixing["day"], "quotes": quotes, "simple": simple, "continuous": continuous, "maturity": maturity_years}

1628: def calibrate_gbm(close: pd.Series) -> dict:

1637:         "vol": vol,

1639:         "level_drift": log_drift + 0.5 * vol * vol,

1750: shibor_discount_rate:
1751: 
1752: ```python
1753: def shibor_discount_rate(shibor: pd.DataFrame, valuation: date, maturity_years: float) -> dict:
1754:     low, high = SHIBOR_TENOR_YEARS[0], SHIBOR_TENOR_YEARS[-1]
1755:     if not low <= maturity_years <= high:
1756:         raise ValueError(
1757:             f"maturity of {maturity_years} years is outside the quoted SHIBOR tenor range "
1758:             f"[{low:.4f}, {high:.0f}] years; interpolation without extrapolation is impossible"
1759:         )
1760:     usable = shibor.loc[shibor["day"] <= valuation].sort_values("day")
1761:     if usable.empty:
1762:         raise ValueError(f"no SHIBOR fixing on or before {valuation.isoformat()} (fixings start {shibor['day'].iloc[0].isoformat()})")
1763:     fixing = usable.iloc[-1]
1764:     quotes = np.array([float(fixing[column]) for column in SHIBOR_RATE_COLUMNS])
1765:     if not np.all(np.isfinite(quotes)):
1766:         raise ValueError(f"SHIBOR fixing {fixing['day'].isoformat()} has missing tenor quotes; cannot interpolate")
1767:     simple_quote = float(np.interp(maturity_years, SHIBOR_TENOR_YEARS, quotes))
1768:     discount_rate = math.log1p(simple_quote * maturity_years) / maturity_years  # careful maturity_years>0
1769:     return {"fixing_date": fixing["day"], "maturity_years": maturity_years, "simple_quote": simple_quote, "discount_rate": discount_rate}
1770: ```
1771: 
1772: maturity must also be > 0 for log1p(r*T)/T: negative maturity caught by range check (maturity<1/365 → out of range). maturity=0 → 0 < low → out of range. Good.

def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

def load_manifest(path: Path = METADATA_PATH) -> dict:
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise VerificationError(f"manifest not found: {path}") from exc
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise VerificationError(f"manifest {path} is not valid JSON: {exc}") from exc
    validate_manifest(manifest)

def validate_manifest(manifest: dict) -> None:
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or not isinstance(manifest.get("q2"), dict):

    datasets = manifest["q2"].get("datasets")
    if not isinstance(datasets, dict) or not datasets:
        raise VerificationError("manifest 'q2.datasets' is missing or empty")
    for name, spec in datasets.items():
        missing = [key for key in ("label", "access", "raw", "clean") if key not in spec]
        if missing:
            raise VerificationError(f"{name}: manifest entry missing {', '.join(missing)}")
        for stage in ("raw", "clean"):
